plan.title: Consumer @deftai GitHub Packages scope 404s public @deftai/directive even with --registry npmjs

narratives.Description: Consumer @deftai GitHub Packages scope 404s public @deftai/directive even with --registry npmjs
narratives.Overview:
## Context

Consumer `deftai/deftvisage`. Operator asked to `npm update deft` after a CLEAN merge. Global CLI was `@deftai/directive@0.113.2`; public npm latest is `0.114.0`. Project `.npmrc` sets `@deftai:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com` then overrides individual `@deftai/directive*` packages to `https://registry.npmjs.org`.

`task feedback:file` not used: `plan.policy.valueFeedback.upstreamPrompt=false`. Operator asked to file Directive issues encountered during this work. Refs #1709. Related to consumer #4343 (gated ritual / npm-registry-mirror).

Not classified as adoption-blocker (workaround: `cd $HOME && npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`).

## Expected

`npm view @deftai/directive version` from the consumer repo root (or `npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest`) resolves the **public** package, matching project `.npmrc` per-package overrides and USER.md / doctor recovery (`--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`).

## Actual

From the consumer repo root:

```
npm view @deftai/directive version
npm view @deftai/directive version --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/
```

both hit `GET https://npm.pkg.github.com/@deftai%2fdirective` → **404** (`npm package "directive" does not exist under owner "deftai"`). Scoped `@deftai:registry=github` wins over `--registry`. Doctor then reports `npm-registry-mirror` as a **hard** gated-ritual error even though the CLI is meant to live on public npm.

From `$HOME` with user `.npmrc` `@deftai:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`, `npm view` returns `0.114.0` and `npm i -g @deftai/directive@latest --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` succeeded (global now 0.114.0).

## Repro

1. Clone a consumer whose `.npmrc` has `@deftai:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com` plus per-package public overrides for `@deftai/directive*`.
2. `cd` that repo. `npm view @deftai/directive version`.
3. Observe GitHub Packages 404.

## Notes

Consumer agents following “npm update deft” without changing cwd will fail closed. Doctor treating this as a gated-ritual hard error blocked `deft verify:session-ritual -- --tier=gated` in the same session (#4343).

### Comment by @MScottAdams (2026-09-11T00:02:08Z)

model: grok-4.6
role: critic

Refutation of comment 5627101481 `refutation-target:`. Pin reads: git show fec1dee399d0844c09a51845137ba6d50bbcbb0f:. Input ceiling 5627101481 inclusive. Round 1, N=1, fresh. No comments after the ceiling were read.

Recorded target, attacked as written: from a consumer repo whose .npmrc sets @deftai:registry=GitHub Packages plus per-package public overrides for @deftai/directive*, npm view @deftai/directive and --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ MUST resolve the public package, and doctor npm-registry-mirror MUST NOT fail-close gated session ritual.

The compound MUST cannot bind.

## 1. Consumer-cwd npm view MUST resolve public

Class: blocks-the-design

Evidence. npm's own scope model: a scope only ever points to one registry (docs.npmjs.com cli v11 using-npm/scope, "Associating a scope with a registry"). npm/cli#7659 (2024-07, npm 10.8.0): `npm view <pkg> --registry <other>` from a tree whose `.npmrc` has `@scope:registry` still uses the scoped `.npmrc` registry; leaving the project directory is the path that works. Same class as archived npm/npm#19517 (2018). Local npm here is 11.16.0. I did not write a probe `.npmrc` (process-only dest, no mutation lease); the CLI issue is independent of this tree.

At the pin, Directive tests treat `--registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/` as the bypass. `packages/core/src/doctor/npm-view.test.ts` and `packages/core/src/content-contracts/standards/npm_registry_mirror.test.ts` assert that argv token. `spawnSync` is mocked. That is a claim, not evidence that npm honors the flag against `@deftai:registry`. `defaultNpmViewVersion` (`packages/core/src/doctor/npm-view.ts`) and session `defaultNpmView` (`packages/core/src/session/release-availability.ts`) inherit process.cwd() and do not pass a userconfig or cwd that unsets the scoped key.

npm's published routing key is `@scope:registry`. The docs do not define `@scope/pkg:registry` as a registry primitive. The issue's "per-package public overrides for @deftai/directive*" are not a mechanism the MUST can rest on.

Failure mode. Bind this conjunct and the next-build contract requires Directive to make `npm view` succeed from a GitHub-Packages-scoped consumer cwd. That is either an npm CLI change or a rewrite of `@deftai:registry` that would 404 every other `@deftai/*` package the consumer actually hosts on GitHub Packages. Agents that follow the documented `--registry` recovery without changing cwd keep 404ing. The issue body's `$HOME` workaround is the npm-documented escape, not a hole to invert.

Disposition. Do not accept this conjunct. The recorded target as a whole cannot bind while this half remains.

## 2. doctor npm-registry-mirror MUST NOT fail-close gated ritual

Class: sharpens-framing

Evidence at the pin. `runNpmRegistryMirrorCheck` emits `severity: "warning"` only (`packages/core/src/doctor/npm-registry.ts`). `packages/core/src/doctor/network-gate.test.ts` runs `cmdDoctor` with a non-public registry and `expect(exitCode).toBe(0)`. Doctor `exitCode = errorCount > 0 ? 1 : 0` (`packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts`). Gated ritual records `ok: code === 0` (`runGatedStep` in `packages/core/src/session/verify-session-ritual.ts`). Warnings do not fail the doctor step. UNRESOLVED copy is `lastErrorCount > 0` (`renderDoctorStatusLine` in `packages/core/src/doctor/doctor-state.ts`); that file already says advisory warnings do not block writes.

Issue 4343 Actual item 2 mixes the `npm-registry-mirror` advisory with hundreds of `completed-open-items` and calls the mix a hard error. At this SHA `completed-open-items` is in `DOCTOR_ADVISORY_FAIL_CHECKS` (`packages/core/src/doctor/checks.ts`). The field "hard gated-ritual error" is a mixed-cause diagnosis, not a measurement that this check fail-closes.

Failure mode. Binding "MUST NOT fail-close" as if it were an open gap will spawn a severity flip that is already shipped, and will leave the real 404 (`--registry` losing to scoped config) unaddressed.

Disposition. Restating "keep npm-registry-mirror advisory" can bind. Treating fail-close as a hole in this check cannot. This conjunct does not rescue the recorded target.

## 3. Existing #2808 `--registry` pin does not survive project `.npmrc`

Class: sharpens-framing

Inventory before any new check. Already present at the pin: offline `npm config get` + URL redaction (`runNpmRegistryMirrorCheck`); `--network` payload-staleness; session release-availability advisory (fail-open on npm view failure); UPGRADING.md "one command" recovery `npm i -g @deftai/directive@<version> --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`; durable `@deftai:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`. `content/tools/package-manager-network.md` claims the `--registry` pin means a configured mirror cannot silently report an old latest release. All of that rest on the same argv token npm/cli#7659 says scoped `.npmrc` beats.

Failure mode. Leaving the documented recovery as `--registry` from project cwd reprints the field 404. Adding a new doctor check that parses per-package `.npmrc` keys would also fail (those keys are not npm routing) and would read untrusted config that can hold tokens.

Disposition. If a later lean binds anything, it is "Directive-owned npm view and documented recovery must not treat `--registry` as beating `@deftai:registry`" while keeping the advisory. That is not an accept of the recorded target.

Injection / swarm. The target is registry routing and ritual recording. Project `.npmrc` is untrusted and can carry credentials. The existing check already forbids printing raw URLs (`npm-registry.ts` plus the "never renders a registry URL" test). Do not add a parser of per-package `.npmrc` keys. Do not add a fail-closed `npm view` to gated ritual (`package-manager-network.md`: default doctor and session-ritual must not contact a registry). No worktree or swarm change.

Road-not-taken. Accept the MUST and ship a cwd-local wrapper that forces public `@deftai:registry` for one spawn. Rejected: that wrapper is a Directive-owned probe/docs fix, which contradicts the recorded MUST that the operator/agent `npm view` from consumer cwd must succeed without changing npm's scope model.

Steelman. The operator-visible failure is real: from the repo the agent was told not to leave, the documented `--registry` recovery 404s. That is the #2808 recovery-doc / spawn-cwd hole in finding 3, not proof that consumer-cwd `npm view` MUST resolve. What would flip finding 1: npm honors `--registry` over `@scope:registry`. The 2024 CLI issue and the v11 scope docs still say otherwise. The issue body's `$HOME` workaround already names the working path.

model: grok-4.6
role: parent

## In plain English

The filed MUST cannot bind. From a consumer cwd whose `.npmrc` maps `@deftai` to GitHub Packages, npm will not let `--registry` or per-package override keys make `npm view @deftai/directive` hit public npm. The doctor `npm-registry-mirror` check is already an advisory warning and does not fail gated ritual by itself. What is still wrong is Directive's own `--registry` recovery pin, which reprints that 404 from project cwd.

Confirming this map recuts 4345. Next-build is not this body. Keep the check advisory. Stop claiming `--registry` beats `@deftai:registry`. Do not parse per-package `.npmrc` keys. Do not add a fail-closed registry probe to gated ritual.

This is not an instruction to a later builder.

Forward verdict: recut. Disposition: all three headings accept-into-contract. Residual: none. The arc does not change npm's scope model and does not decide how a consumer hosts other `@deftai/*` packages.

Recut: next-build contract is not this body.

## Bound remedy

- Keep `npm-registry-mirror` as an advisory warning. Do not treat it as a gated-ritual fail-close hole.
- Do not bind "consumer-cwd `npm view @deftai/directive` MUST resolve public" while `@deftai:registry` points at GitHub Packages.
- Recut Directive-owned `npm view` and documented recovery so they do not treat `--registry` as beating `@deftai:registry`. Name a path that unsets or overrides the scoped key (cwd change, userconfig, or durable `@deftai:registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/`).
- Do not parse per-package `.npmrc` keys. Do not print registry URLs. Do not add a fail-closed `npm view` to default doctor or gated ritual.
